source: make a pvp sniper game that has maps like nuketown a call of duty look to it with a home screen the a play arena

image_prompt.text: Waist-high and full-body cover - fences, parked cars, yard props - spread across the routes between the two houses
Narrow pinch points where the side yards meet the central street
Two opposing spawns at either end of the compact suburban block, shielded from each other's sniper lines
a compact symmetrical suburban block with two facing houses across a central street, in the style of a Call of Duty map
long uninterrupted sightlines across the map for sniper duels
a separate home-screen scene the player sees before entering the arena

layout_placement.text: Balanced opposing team spawns at opposite ends of the block

notes: P4 because the home screen and the play arena are two separate maps.
The single most specific instruction - build it like Nuketown - has no field to carry it and survives only as free text.
Sniper play wants long sightlines, which sits in tension with the preset's evenly distributed cover; flagged rather than resolved.

open_questions.ask: Is the home screen a 2D menu, or a small 3D scene you walk out of into the arena?
You said maps plural - how many arenas, or is Nuketown-style the only one for now?
Snipers only, or other weapons too? It changes how open the map should be.

coverage_missing.ask: Is the home screen a UI menu or a buildable lobby space?
Teams, or free-for-all? PvP alone does not say.
Nuketown-tight, or a bigger block with longer lanes?

answers.ask: Is the home screen a 2D menu, or a small 3D scene you walk out of into the arena?
answers.answer: Use a simple 2D home screen with a Play button that sends players into the arena.

answers.ask: You said maps plural - how many arenas, or is Nuketown-style the only one for now?
answers.answer: Start with one small Nuketown-style arena for the first build.
